entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elisabeth von Janota-Bzowski was a German graphic artist known for her postage stamps and magazine designs. Born in Kiel, Schleswig-Holstein Province, in 1912, Von Janota-Bzowski sold her first art as a teenager.
